context: Aoi shops for clothes; asks a store clerk about sizes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: すみません、店員さん、このサイズ、ありますか?
lines.en: Excuse me — do you have this in my size?
lines.style: soft polite adult woman voice, warm friendly delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、少々お待ちください、確認します。
lines.en: Yes, one moment please, I'll check.
lines.style: composed clerk-mode office woman voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: これ、限定の商品なんですか?
lines.style: curious adult woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、今月だけの限定です。
lines.en: Yes, it's limited to this month only.
lines.style: gentle office woman voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 丁寧に教えてくださって、ありがとう。
lines.en: Thank you for explaining so kindly.
lines.style: tender adult woman voice, soft warm grateful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: またお越しくださいね。
lines.style: warm office woman voice, soft warm courteous delivery carefully
